title: Antisemitismus zwischen Latenz und Leidenschaft
summary: Antisemitism as a passionate (re)interpretation of the world has been resonating beyond the circle of the „usual suspects“ in right-wing extremism since before October 7th 2023. This volume explores the persistence, adaptability and global spread of anti-Jewish ideas and manifestations and traces them from antiquity to the Telegram chats, university auditoriums and cultural institutions of the contemporary world.
